Title: Q1 27 Earnings Themes
Summary: Revenue pressure came mainly from Sportswear, Jordan, and China, while Running, Global Football, Training, and Basketball showed healthier demand signals.

Stats.Label: Max Cushioning
Stats.Value: Share tripled over the past year

Themes.Name: Sportswear
Themes.Headline: Large drag from lifestyle franchises
Details: Down low double digits and accounted for roughly half of Q1 27 revenue.
Dunk revenue was reduced by 50% in Q1 27.
AF1 is still driving stable full-price business.
P-6000 and V5 Runner grew strong double digits.
Studio Fleece was the best-performing apparel collection across Nike in Q1 27.
Nike is breaking Sportswear into smaller areas of focus.

Themes.Name: Jordan
Themes.Headline: Scarcity reset is weighing on volume
Details: Jordan Brand is 13% of the business and declined mid-teens.
Nike is reducing the volume and frequency of specific Jordan 1 Retro launches.
Management is leaning back into scarcity.

Themes.Name: China
Themes.Headline: Distribution cleanup and retail reset
Details: Revenue declined 26%.
Nike is eliminating distribution to reduce discounting.
The focus is shifting toward more inspirational brick-and-mortar retail experiences.
Shanghai House of Innovation has delivered 10 consecutive months of growth since the shift.

Themes.Name: Running
Themes.Headline: Clear momentum in performance running
Details: Running was up double digits with consistent share gains.
Max cushioning worked, with Vomero showing strength.
Nike tripled share of the max cushioning category over the past year.
Next phase is three racing silos and one Pegasus silo.
Pegasus Plus 2 arrived in August.
Alphafly 4 was unveiled in September.
Swooshfly and Nike Apex were introduced at the end of September.

Themes.Name: Global Football
Themes.Headline: World Cup drove demand
Details: World Cup team kit sales doubled compared with 2022.
Haaland's PE added another athlete-led product signal.

Themes.Name: Training
Themes.Headline: New franchises gaining traction
Details: Nike Mind has become one of the top-selling franchises.
Nike Pro and Metcon remain strong.
Nike hybrid footwear has been introduced.
Hyperslide adds a recovery angle.

Themes.Name: Basketball
Themes.Headline: Signature demand remained strong
Details: Caitlin 1 distribution was about 2x an average Nike basketball signature shoe and sold out.
